parameters.EDS_SQL: BEGIN TRY UPDATE EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM SET [ISLATEST] = 0 ,[SCD_END_DATE] = ( SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM tgt INNER JOIN D360.L1_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM src ON src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[PARAM_ID] = tgt.[PARAM_ID] AND src.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[PARAM_DESC], src.[FROM_VALUE], src.[TO_VALUE])) <> HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[PARAM_DESC], tgt.[FROM_VALUE], tgt.[TO_VALUE])); INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM ( AS_OF_DATE ,BANK_ID ,PARAM_TYPE ,PARAM_ID ,PARAM_DESC ,FROM_VALUE ,TO_VALUE ,LAST_UPDATED_DATE ,LAST_UPDATE_BY ,ISLATEST ,ISACTIVE ,SCD_START_DATE ,SCD_END_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE ,BANK_ID ,PARAM_TYPE ,PARAM_ID ,PARAM_DESC ,FROM_VALUE ,TO_VALUE ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE) AS LAST_UPDATED_DATE ,'EDS_ETLUSER' AS LAST_UPDATE_BY ,1 AS [ISLATEST] ,1 AS [ISACTIVE] ,AS_OF_DATE AS SCD_START_DATE ,CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE] FROM D360.L1_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM src WHERE src.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM tgt WHERE src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[PARAM_ID] = tgt.[PARAM_ID] AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[PARAM_DESC], src.[FROM_VALUE], src.[TO_VALUE])) = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[PARAM_DESC], tgt.[FROM_VALUE], tgt.[TO_VALUE])) AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 ); END TRY BEGIN CATCH DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE(); THROW 51000 ,@msg ,1; END CATCH

BEGIN TRY UPDATE EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM SET [ISLATEST] = 0 ,[SCD_END_DATE] = ( SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM tgt INNER JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM src ON src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[PARAM_ID] = tgt.[SEGMENT_ID] AND 'L1' = tgt.[SEGMENT_TYPE] AND CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) between src.SCD_START_DATE AND src.SCD_END_DATE WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[PARAM_DESC], '|')) <> HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[SEGMENT_DESC], '|')); INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM ( BANK_ID, SEGMENT_ID, SEGMENT_TYPE, SEGMENT_DESC, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_BY, ISLATEST, ISACTIVE, SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT SRC.BANK_ID, SRC.PARAM_ID AS SEGMENT_ID, 'L1' AS SEGMENT_TYPE, SRC.PARAM_DESC AS SEGMENT_DESC, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS Date) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'EDS_ETLUSER' AS LAST_UPDATE_BY, 1 AS [ISLATEST], 1 AS [ISACTIVE], AS_OF_DATE AS SCD_START_DATE, CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE] FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM src WHERE CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) between src.SCD_START_DATE AND src.SCD_END_DATE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM tgt WHERE src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[PARAM_ID] = tgt.[SEGMENT_ID] AND 'L1' = tgt.[SEGMENT_TYPE] AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[PARAM_DESC], '|')) = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[SEGMENT_DESC], '|')) AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 ); END TRY BEGIN CATCH DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE(); THROW 51000 ,@msg ,1; END CATCH

BEGIN TRY CREATE TABLE #SRC_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT WITH ( DISTRIBUTION = HASH(CIF) ) AS SELECT ECD.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID, ECD.ORGKEY  AS CIF, CTR.CUST_SEGMENT_ID AS L1_SEGMENT_ID, CSP.PARAM_DESC AS L1_SEGMENT_DESC, DPMS.L2_SEGMENT_ID AS L2_SEGMENT_ID, DPMS.L2_SEGMENT_DESC AS L2_SEGMENT_DESC, CTR_PM.L1_SEGMENT_ID AS PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID, CTR_PM.L2_SEGMENT_ID AS PREV_L2_SEGMENT_ID FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL CTR ON ECD.ORGKEY = CTR.CIF AND ECD.BANK_ID = CTR.BANK_ID AND CTR.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM CSP ON CTR.CUST_SEGMENT_ID = CSP.PARAM_ID AND CTR.BANK_ID = CSP.BANK_ID AND CTR.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CSP.SCD_START_DATE AND CSP.SCD_END_DATE LEFT JOIN EDS.DSD_PROD_MODEL_SCORES DPMS ON DPMS.CIF_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND DPMS.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM DD ON DD.FULLDATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT CTR_PM ON CTR_PM.SCD_START_DATE = DD.PREVIOUS_MONTH_LAST_BUS_DAY AND ECD.ORGKEY = CTR_PM.CIF AND ECD.BANK_ID = CTR_PM.BANK_ID WHERE CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE UPDATE EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT SET [ISLATEST] = 0 ,[SCD_END_DATE] = ( SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT tgt INNER JOIN #SRC_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT src ON src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[CIF] = tgt.[CIF] WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], src.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])) <> HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])); INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT ( BANK_ID, CIF, L1_SEGMENT_ID, L1_SEGMENT_DESC, L1_PROMOTION_DATE, L1_DEMOTION_DATE, L1_PROMOTION_BY, L1_DEMOTION_BY, L2_SEGMENT_ID, L2_SEGMENT_DESC, L2_PROMOTION_DATE, L2_DEMOTION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_BY, ISLATEST, ISACTIVE, SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT BANK_ID, CIF, L1_SEGMENT_ID, L1_SEGMENT_DESC, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) < CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L1_PROMOTION_DATE, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) > CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L1_DEMOTION_DATE, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) < CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN 'EDS_ETLUSER' ELSE NULL END) AS L1_PROMOTION_BY, (CASE WHEN CAST(L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) > CAST(PREV_L1_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN 'EDS_ETLUSER' ELSE NULL END) AS L1_DEMOTION_BY, L2_SEGMENT_ID, L2_SEGMENT_DESC, (CASE WHEN CAST(L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) < CAST(PREV_L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L2_PROMOTION_DATE, (CASE WHEN CAST(L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) > CAST(PREV_L2_SEGMENT_ID AS NUMERIC(38,0)) THEN CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ELSE NULL END) AS L2_DEMOTION_DATE, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS Date) AS LAST_UPDATED_DATE, 'EDS_ETLUSER' AS LAST_UPDATE_BY, 1 AS [ISLATEST], 1 AS [ISACTIVE], CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE, CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE] FROM #SRC_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT src WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT tgt WHERE src.[BANK_ID] = tgt.[BANK_ID] AND src.[CIF] = tgt.[CIF] AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], src.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], src.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])) = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L1_SEGMENT_DESC], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_ID], tgt.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC])) AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 ); END TRY BEGIN CATCH DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE(); THROW 51000 ,@msg ,1; END CATCH

IF EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 CNT
		FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN
		WHERE TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL'
			AND PROCESS_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)
		)
BEGIN
	DELETE
	FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL
	WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE);
END;

WITH CUST_TOT_REL_DEP
AS (
	SELECT EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,EDA.BANK_ID BANK_ID
		,ECD.ORGKEY CIF
		,SUM(COALESCE(YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS
		,SUM(COALESCE(LD9RA.LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS_3MTHS_ADB
		,NULL TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
		,NULL TRB_BANCA
		,NULL TRB_SECURITIES
		,NULL TRE_LOANS
		,NULL TRE_CARDS
		,NULL TRB_BANCA_3MTHS_ADB
		,NULL TRB_SECURITIES_3MTHS_ADB
	FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE
			AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.L1_DEPOSIT_90D_ROLLING_AVG LD9RA ON EDA.CUST_ID = LD9RA.CUST_ID
		AND EDA.ACID = LD9RA.GAM_ACID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = LD9RA.GAM_BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = LD9RA.AS_OF_DATE
	WHERE EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN (
			'M'
			,'J'
			)
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND LEFT(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE, 2) <> '09'
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'
		AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
		AND EDA.DEL_FLG = 'N'
		AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)
		AND TRIM(EDA.CUST_ID) IS NOT NULL
		AND TRIM(EDA.CUST_ID) <> ''
	GROUP BY EDA.AS_OF_DATE
		,EDA.BANK_ID
		,ECD.ORGKEY
	)
	,CUST_TOT_REL_TRY
AS (
	SELECT TAH.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE BANK_ID
		,TAH.CIF_ID CIF
		,SUM(COALESCE(TAH.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP, 0)) TRB_TREASURY
		,SUM(COALESCE(LT9RA.LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP, 0)) TRB_TREASURY_3MTHS_ADB
	FROM EDS.TREASURY_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TAH
	LEFT JOIN EDS.L1_TREASURY_90D_ROLLING_AVG LT9RA ON TAH.CIF_ID = LT9RA.CIF_ID
	AND TAH.LE_ID = LT9RA.LE_ID
	AND TAH.PRODUCT_CODE = LT9RA.PRODUCT_CODE
	AND TAH.ACCT_ID = LT9RA.ACCT_ID
	AND TAH.BANK_ID = LT9RA.BANK_ID
	AND TAH.AS_OF_DATE = LT9RA.AS_OF_DATE
	WHERE TAH.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)
		AND TAH.FOR_EXCLUSION = 'N'
		AND TAH.IS_QUALIFIED = 'Y'
		AND TAH.PRODUCT_GROUP NOT IN (
			'FX Product'
			,'Derivative Product'
			)
	GROUP BY TAH.AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE
		,TAH.CIF_ID
	)
	,CUST_TOT_REL_TRU
AS (
	SELECT TAH.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE BANK_ID
		,TAH.CIF_ID CIF
		,SUM(COALESCE(TAH.MARKET_VALUE_PHP, 0)) TRB_TRUST
		,SUM(COALESCE(LT9RA.LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP, 0)) TRB_TRUST_3MTHS_ADB
	FROM EDS.TRUST_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TAH
	LEFT JOIN EDS.L1_TRUST_90D_ROLLING_AVG LT9RA ON TAH.CIF_ID = LT9RA.CIF_ID
	AND TAH.BASE_NO = LT9RA.BASE_NO
	AND TAH.PRIMARY_FLAG = LT9RA.PRIMARY_FLAG
	AND TAH.PORTFOLIO_NO = LT9RA.PORTFOLIO_NO
	AND TAH.PRODUCT_CODE = LT9RA.PRODUCT_CODE
	AND TAH.NONUITF_SCHEME_CODE = LT9RA.NONUITF_SCHEME_CODE
	AND TAH.NONUITF_AC_NO = LT9RA.NONUITF_AC_NO
	AND TAH.NONUITF_FOLIO_NO = LT9RA.NONUITF_FOLIO_NO
	AND TAH.BANK_ID = LT9RA.BANK_ID
	AND TAH.AS_OF_DATE = LT9RA.AS_OF_DATE
	WHERE TAH.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)
		AND (
			TAH.PRODUCT_GROUP = 'UITF'
			OR TAH.PRODUCT_CODE = 'AIMA'
			)
		AND TAH.IS_QUALIFIED = 'Y'
	GROUP BY TAH.AS_OF_DATE
		,TAH.BNK_CODE
		,TAH.CIF_ID
	)
	,AGG_TRB
AS (
	SELECT DEP.AS_OF_DATE
		,DEP.BANK_ID
		,DEP.CIF
		,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_BANCA, 0)) TRB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0)) TRB_INVEST
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TRUST, 0)) TRB_TRUST
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY, 0)) TRB_TREASURY
		,TRB_BANCA
		,TRB_SECURITIES
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRE_LOANS, 0) + COALESCE(TRE_CARDS, 0)) TRE
		,TRE_LOANS
		,TRE_CARDS
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY_3MTHS_ADB, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST_3MTHS_ADB, 0)) TRB_INVEST_3MTHS_ADB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS_3MTHS_ADB, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY_3MTHS_ADB, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST_3MTHS_ADB, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_BANCA_3MTHS_ADB, 0) + COALESCE(TRB_SECURITIES_3MTHS_ADB, 0)) TRB_3MTHS_ADB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS_3MTHS_ADB, 0)) TRB_DEPOSITS_3MTHS_ADB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TRUST_3MTHS_ADB, 0)) TRB_TRUST_3MTHS_ADB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY_3MTHS_ADB, 0)) TRB_TREASURY_3MTHS_ADB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_BANCA_3MTHS_ADB, 0)) TRB_BANCA_3MTHS_ADB
		,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_SECURITIES_3MTHS_ADB, 0)) TRB_SECURITIES_3MTHS_ADB
	FROM CUST_TOT_REL_DEP DEP
	LEFT JOIN CUST_TOT_REL_TRY TRY ON DEP.CIF = TRY.CIF
		AND DEP.BANK_ID = TRY.BANK_ID
		AND DEP.AS_OF_DATE = TRY.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN CUST_TOT_REL_TRU TRU ON DEP.CIF = TRU.CIF
		AND DEP.BANK_ID = TRU.BANK_ID
		AND DEP.AS_OF_DATE = TRU.AS_OF_DATE
	GROUP BY DEP.AS_OF_DATE
		,DEP.BANK_ID
		,DEP.CIF
		,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
		,TRB_BANCA
		,TRB_SECURITIES
		,TRE_LOANS
		,TRE_CARDS
	)
INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL (
	AS_OF_DATE
	,BANK_ID
	,CIF
	,CUST_SEGMENT_ID
	,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
	,TRB
	,TRB_DEPOSITS
	,TRB_INVEST
	,TRB_TRUST
	,TRB_TREASURY
	,TRB_BANCA
	,TRB_SECURITIES
	,TRE
	,TRE_LOANS
	,TRE_CARDS
	,TRB_INVEST_3MTHS_ADB
	,TRB_3MTHS_ADB
	,TRB_DEPOSITS_3MTHS_ADB
	,TRB_TRUST_3MTHS_ADB
	,TRB_TREASURY_3MTHS_ADB
	,TRB_BANCA_3MTHS_ADB
	,TRB_SECURITIES_3MTHS_ADB
	)
SELECT AGG_TRB.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
	,AGG_TRB.BANK_ID
	,AGG_TRB.CIF
	,COALESCE(CSP.PARAM_ID, '006') AS CUST_SEGMENT_ID
	,AGG_TRB.TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
	,AGG_TRB.TRB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_DEPOSITS
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_INVEST
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_TRUST
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_TREASURY
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_BANCA
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_SECURITIES
	,AGG_TRB.TRE
	,AGG_TRB.TRE_LOANS
	,AGG_TRB.TRE_CARDS
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_INVEST_3MTHS_ADB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_3MTHS_ADB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_DEPOSITS_3MTHS_ADB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_TRUST_3MTHS_ADB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_TREASURY_3MTHS_ADB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_BANCA_3MTHS_ADB
	,AGG_TRB.TRB_SECURITIES_3MTHS_ADB
FROM AGG_TRB
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM CSP ON CSP.BANK_ID = AGG_TRB.BANK_ID
	AND COALESCE(TRB, 0) BETWEEN CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(CSP.FROM_VALUE, '0'), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38, 6))
		AND CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(CSP.TO_VALUE, '999,999,999,999,999'), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38, 6))
	AND AGG_TRB.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CSP.SCD_START_DATE
		AND CSP.SCD_END_DATE

parameters.EDS_SQL: BEGIN TRY  UPDATE    EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM  SET    [ISLATEST] = 0,    [SCD_END_DATE] = (     SELECT        PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY      FROM        EDS.DATE_DIM      WHERE        FULLDATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)   )  FROM    EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM tgt    INNER JOIN EDS.DSD_PROD_MODEL_SCORES src ON 'CBC01' = tgt.[BANK_ID]    AND src.[L2_SEGMENT_ID] = tgt.[SEGMENT_ID]    AND 'L2' = tgt.[SEGMENT_TYPE]    AND CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) = src.AS_OF_DATE WHERE    tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1    AND HASHBYTES(     'SHA2_256',      CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC], '|')   ) <> HASHBYTES(     'SHA2_256',      CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[SEGMENT_DESC], '|')   ); INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM (   BANK_ID,    SEGMENT_ID,    SEGMENT_TYPE,    SEGMENT_DESC,    LAST_UPDATE_DATE,    LAST_UPDATE_BY,    ISLATEST,    ISACTIVE,    SCD_START_DATE,    SCD_END_DATE )  SELECT    DISTINCT 'CBC01' AS BANK_ID,    SRC.L2_SEGMENT_ID AS SEGMENT_ID,    'L2' AS SEGMENT_TYPE,    SRC.L2_SEGMENT_DESC AS SEGMENT_DESC,    CAST(     SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS Date   ) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE,    'EDS_ETLUSER' AS LAST_UPDATE_BY,    1 AS [ISLATEST],    1 AS [ISACTIVE],    AS_OF_DATE AS SCD_START_DATE,    CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE]  FROM    EDS.DSD_PROD_MODEL_SCORES src  WHERE    CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) = AS_OF_DATE   AND NOT EXISTS (     SELECT        1      FROM        EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_DIM tgt      WHERE        'CBC01' = tgt.[BANK_ID]        AND src.[L2_SEGMENT_ID] = tgt.[SEGMENT_ID]        AND 'L2' = tgt.[SEGMENT_TYPE]        AND HASHBYTES(         'SHA2_256',          CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[L2_SEGMENT_DESC], '|')       ) = HASHBYTES(         'SHA2_256',          CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[SEGMENT_DESC], '|')       )        AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1   ); END TRY BEGIN CATCH DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE(); THROW 51000,  @msg,  1; END CATCH

DELETE FROM EDS.L1_DEPOSIT_90D_ROLLING_AVG WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE); WITH DAT AS ( SELECT FULLDATE AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD WHERE DD.MONTH_END = 'Y' AND DD.FULLDATE > DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE))), MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE))), 1) AND DD.FULLDATE <= CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) INSERT INTO EDS.L1_DEPOSIT_90D_ROLLING_AVG ( AS_OF_DATE ,CUST_ID ,GAM_ACID ,GAM_BANK_ID ,AGG_DAY_NO ,LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR ,LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_PHP ,LAST_3MTHS_ADB_ORIG_CURR ,LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP ,BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE ,INSERT_DTTM ) SELECT CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE ,DF.CUST_ID ,DF.GAM_ACID ,DF.GAM_BANK_ID ,SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS AGG_DAY_NO ,SUM(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR) AS LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR ,SUM(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP) AS LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_PHP ,SUM(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR) / SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS LAST_3MTHS_ADB_ORIG_CURR ,SUM(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP) / SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP ,DF.GAM_BANK_ID AS [BNK_CODE] ,'DEP' AS [SOURCE_CODE] ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) FROM DAT INNER JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT DF ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE = DF.AS_OF_DATE GROUP BY DF.CUST_ID ,DF.GAM_ACID ,DF.GAM_BANK_ID

DELETE FROM EDS.L1_TREASURY_90D_ROLLING_AVG WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE); WITH DAT AS ( SELECT FULLDATE AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD WHERE DD.MONTH_END = 'Y' AND DD.FULLDATE > DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE))), MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE))), 1) AND DD.FULLDATE <= CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) INSERT INTO EDS.L1_TREASURY_90D_ROLLING_AVG ( AS_OF_DATE ,CIF_ID ,PRIMARY_FLAG ,LE_ID ,PRODUCT_GROUP ,PRODUCT_CODE ,PRODUCT_CODE_FMS ,ISIN ,ACCT_ID ,IS_QUALIFIED ,BANK_ID ,AGG_DAY_NO ,LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR ,LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_PHP ,LAST_3MTHS_ADB_ORIG_CURR ,LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP ,BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE ,INSERT_DTTM ) SELECT CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE ,TF.CIF_ID ,TF.PRIMARY_FLAG ,TF.LE_ID ,TF.PRODUCT_GROUP ,TF.PRODUCT_CODE ,TF.PRODUCT_CODE_FMS ,TF.ISIN ,TF.ACCT_ID ,TF.IS_QUALIFIED ,TF.BANK_ID ,SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(TF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS AGG_DAY_NO ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_ORIG) AS LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_PHP) AS LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_PHP ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_ORIG) / SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(TF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS LAST_3MTHS_ADB_ORIG_CURR ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_PHP) / SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(TF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP ,TF.BNK_CODE ,'TRY' AS [SOURCE_CODE] ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) FROM DAT INNER JOIN EDS.TREASURY_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TF ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE = TF.AS_OF_DATE GROUP BY TF.CIF_ID ,TF.PRIMARY_FLAG ,TF.LE_ID ,TF.PRODUCT_GROUP ,TF.PRODUCT_CODE ,TF.PRODUCT_CODE_FMS ,TF.ISIN ,TF.ACCT_ID ,TF.IS_QUALIFIED ,TF.BANK_ID ,TF.BNK_CODE

DELETE FROM EDS.L1_TRUST_90D_ROLLING_AVG WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE); WITH DAT AS ( SELECT FULLDATE AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD WHERE DD.MONTH_END = 'Y' AND DD.FULLDATE > DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE))), MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, - 2, CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE))), 1) AND DD.FULLDATE <= CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) ) INSERT INTO EDS.L1_TRUST_90D_ROLLING_AVG ( AS_OF_DATE ,CIF_ID ,BASE_NO ,PRIMARY_FLAG ,PORTFOLIO_NO ,SUBSCRIPTION_ID ,PRODUCT_GROUP ,PRODUCT_CODE ,NONUITF_SCHEME_CODE ,NONUITF_AC_NO ,NONUITF_FOLIO_NO ,IS_QUALIFIED ,BASE_NO_UNMASKED ,PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED ,AGG_DAY_NO ,LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR ,LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_PHP ,LAST_3MTHS_ADB_ORIG_CURR ,LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP ,BNK_CODE ,BANK_ID ,SOURCE_CODE ,INSERT_DTTM ) SELECT CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE ,TF.CIF_ID ,TF.BASE_NO ,TF.PRIMARY_FLAG ,TF.PORTFOLIO_NO ,TF.SUBSCRIPTION_ID ,TF.PRODUCT_GROUP ,TF.PRODUCT_CODE ,TF.NONUITF_SCHEME_CODE ,TF.NONUITF_AC_NO ,TF.NONUITF_FOLIO_NO ,TF.IS_QUALIFIED ,TF.BASE_NO_UNMASKED ,TF.PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED ,SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(TF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS AGG_DAY_NO ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_MKT_ORIG) AS [LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR] ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_MKT_PHP) AS [LAST_3MTHS_AGG_BAL_PHP] ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_MKT_ORIG) / SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(TF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS [LAST_3MTHS_ADB_ORIG_CURR] ,SUM(TF.MTD_AGG_BAL_MKT_PHP) / SUM(DAY(EOMONTH(TF.AS_OF_DATE))) AS [LAST_3MTHS_ADB_PHP] ,TF.BNK_CODE ,TF.BANK_ID ,'TRU' AS [SOURCE_CODE] ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) FROM DAT INNER JOIN EDS.TRUST_ACCOUNT_HOLDER TF ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE = TF.AS_OF_DATE GROUP BY TF.CIF_ID ,TF.BASE_NO ,TF.PRIMARY_FLAG ,TF.PORTFOLIO_NO ,TF.SUBSCRIPTION_ID ,TF.PRODUCT_GROUP ,TF.PRODUCT_CODE ,TF.NONUITF_SCHEME_CODE ,TF.NONUITF_AC_NO ,TF.NONUITF_FOLIO_NO ,TF.IS_QUALIFIED ,TF.BASE_NO_UNMASKED ,TF.PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED ,TF.BNK_CODE ,TF.BANK_ID
